steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: These are ordinary civilians, and even with combat experience, they can't be difficult to deal with, but...
More people are gathering, and although they can't see the Nightmare, the Sinner's power has clearly aroused suspicion.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, we're attracting too much unwanted attention.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Hehe, just double the payment for hush money now, and I'll help you cover this up. I'll even throw in a complimentary tune...

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Coming up next... Good Day!
She laughs and actually picks up the suona again to play a tune.
Let him go...!
Thump! A shadow falls from the sky and smashes heavily into the ground. It's a person wearing a hood, and on closer inspection...
She maintains a handsome pose on one knee, silent, cold, and stolid, like a monument, attracting everyone's attention. Ten, twenty seconds, everyone holds their breath to keep the silence.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Um... ${PlayerName}...

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Give me a hand...

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I jumped down too fast, and my feet are numb...
You rush forward to help her up. The Sinner with a superb tolerance for pain is actually grimacing a little.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I've been waiting here to meet up with you. Adjutant Nightingale heard of your plans and came to me. I used to live in Drifter Camp before you caught me.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No restraints, no trackers, she just put you back in an uncontrolled area... What was Adjutant Nightingale thinking? Wasn't she afraid you would escape?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: ...Let's deal with the trouble at hand first.
She turns to face the residents holding pots and pans in their hands, who finally come around and start yelling.

steps.speaker: Angry Middle-aged Man
steps.content: Now you're back?! That Whitestone boss of yours... Had drinks at my place for months and never paid a nickel! I want my money back!

steps.speaker: Howling Woman
steps.content: You people agreed to pay for ads this month but vanished last week. Do you know how many punches I got for putting up ads for your?! Pay up!

steps.speaker: Vengeful Man
steps.content: Hey, why are you siding with the intruders? Can't pay us back, so you're selling Drifter Camp out?!

steps.speaker: Gentle Old Man
steps.content: K.K., I know you are a good child. It must have been difficult for you... You can tell me about it...

steps.speaker: Gentle Old Man
steps.content: But do you remember... August 13 last year, my grandson's birthday, I ordered an Eastside smuggled cake from the south, and you still haven't delivered... Can I get a refund?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Well... Um...
The girl with pink twin ponytails leaps and gives K.K. a big hug.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: You should have told me! I thought he was a debt collector. But is this another one you've tricked, um, is this another investor? Great!
steps.female_content: You should have told me! I thought she was a debt collector. But is this another one you've tricked, um, is this another investor? Great!

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Oh, neighbors, don't worry! For the past six months, Whitestone didn't go bankrupt and run away. K.K. has been looking for a way to save the company, and now she's finally found it!
She turns around and points at you.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: This is not an intruder. He's a rich guy from the Outlands, and the Sinner next to him is a bodyguard he hired at a heavy price, so don't mess with them again for your safety.
steps.female_content: This is not an intruder. She's a rich gal from the Outlands, and the Sinner next to her is a bodyguard she hired at a heavy price, so don't mess with them again for your safety.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: He came here to invest in the business opportunities of the redevelopment of West District, and we were discussing investment in Whitestone Industries for the future of Syndicate!
steps.female_content: She came here to invest in the business opportunities of the redevelopment of West District, and we were discussing investment in Whitestone Industries for the future of Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Right, K.K.? Good job!

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Yeah, yeah... no matter what those two at Whitestone owe you, K.K. will pay it back!
People begin whispering to each other, but you can see K.K.'s ears reddening a bit under the hood. And some people are looking at you with sympathy in their eyes.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Hehe... Sorry, nice neighbors, turns out it was a misunderstanding. K.K.'s friends are my friends. Don't get mad. Just go back to your dinner!

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Or, how about a little tune for your appetite?
As the girl picks up her beloved... suona? People drop their doubts and scatter, leaving the few of you there.
Dudu is still holding K.K., smiling but not saying anything.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: ...Okay, okay... Put it on my tab. I owe you a lot more, anyway.
Lying in public seems to have drained all of K.K.'s strength, and with one hand covering her blushing face, she breathlessly answers Hecate's question.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I won't run away... I need to get you back to MBCC to complete the commission. Adjutant Nightingale promised a commission fee... and I have to get it.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: ...I just went back to the store to check. Those two already owe 8 months of rent and utilities, and the door is sealed... So...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Back to the point. Do you know this Sinner?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: You mean Dudu?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I need to know what's going on and what to do about it.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Sigh... You'd better pay the hush money. She's an honest businesswoman, at least. It'll cost a lot, but the Bureau will reimburse you, right?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I really don't want a commission to catch my neighbor.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Oh? Do you want to pay up now? Okay, let's do the math.
She pulls out an abacus and starts to count.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: There's faking your death, your Bureau identity, the shackle, helping you explain just now, and... Oh! And 10 great suona tunes...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Wait, when did I get 10 songs?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: When you were lying unconscious in that little box, I played a long, long song to wake you up. It's all because of my healing song that you don't have any broken bones or concussions! Count yourself lucky that I'm only charging you for 10 songs.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: All right! That's 20,000 DisCoins in total!
You hear K.K. draw a cold breath and see her grimace at you. Dudu, on the other hand, looks at you with a smug, condescending expression.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: No, no deal! Aren't you with the authorities? Why are you so cheap?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: No, no, this is the best deal you'll get. I'd lose too much otherwise, so take it or leave it!

steps.speaker: Choice - 1
options: 17,500, I'll get an advance on next month's salary.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: 19,500! My last offer! A friendly price for K.K.! No more bargaining! Countdown to three seconds to close the deal. Three... One!
Poor Syndicate. Prices really are ridiculously low here.
You are about to feel sorry for the low prices of Syndicate when Dudu shows a sly expression.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Oh, I almost forgot. The economy has been tough lately, and we have to multiply the inflation factor...
No more, no more. You have my word.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: One more question, and you can charge me extra for this.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You do know a lot. Where did you hear those things? Tell me, and I'll pay you whatever you want.
Dudu's smile stiffens for a moment, and she looks at you with alarm.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Huh...? I am all-knowing.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you were all-knowing, we wouldn't have run into so many accidents. You must have heard about me in advance, but where?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Hmph... You can't afford the answer, and I'm not putting a price on it.
You step forward. If it's necessary... even in someone else's territory, you will use force.
But you suddenly feel a chill brush across the back of your neck. This is an extremely deep patio, and there shouldn't be any wind.
A dozen meters away, the walls seem to get darker. From the outline, however, it's a modest one-story bungalow with a long chimney at the back.
A door opens, and a woman leans against the door frame, looking at you.

steps.speaker: Woman in the Shadow
steps.content: Oppression or death... You always assume secrets can be kept by such means.

steps.speaker: Woman in the Shadow
steps.content: There's no use. A lot of people have told me about you already.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I'm not sure where the info is from, but it will be used against you. Remember, from now on, do not reveal your identity or the fact that you are still alive.
Looking at the woman who is quietly staring at you, you understand everything now.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Are you the source of information...?

steps.speaker: Woman in the Shadow
steps.content: …Come in, ${PlayerName}. I'm not used to talking outside.
The woman sidesteps back into the house, leaving only an open, dark door.
